note: Recorded PayPal sandbox run (spike logs in docs/spikes). Ids are copied from those logs; this page does not call PayPal.

items.title: Order, approve, capture
items.what: Orders v2 order approved by the sandbox buyer and captured, with the buyer's PayPal saved to the vault (store_in_vault).

items.title: Buyer-absent re-order
items.what: A second order created with only the vault id, no approval click. This is how Reins pays an auto-approved request.

items.title: Payout batch (treasury mode)
items.what: Payouts API batch from the sandbox business account to the personal account. Batch and item both ended SUCCESS.

items.title: Webhook signature check
items.what: Signed PayPal events passed verify-webhook-signature and were stored once (a resend did not duplicate). A forged request with dummy headers was refused.
